remaining_execution_checks.note: Illustrations sometimes reframe between columns; do not animate that as a camera cut. A generation uses one approved setup. Proposed angles are not measured offsets and newly exposed surfaces remain unapproved. Boards are never bound pixels.

Board uses a close source-like plane side view. New approved opening must demonstrate genuinely changed perspective, original window/engine count and physically plausible ground contact without adding unapproved gear.

Sink/tub scale and edge detail vary in the illustrations. Match actual shell fixtures and outlet, precise waterline and previous-cleaning states; do not accept board stylization as redesigned fixtures.
Lane-one start can read partly clear in the sketch. Reconstruct exact 0/1/2-lane starting states from PLAN.json and preserve one connected waterfall fixture, not separate added waterfalls.

Illustration props are simplified. Exact collectible bundle/bottle/cup forms and counts come from source references; collected supplies must not reappear as loose targets. End-panel reframing is not motion permission.
Residual tabletop speckles can read as grime despite all-clean state. Complete opening must be visibly clean, small and stocked; use authored colour control, not newly invented magic object.

First rescue sketch omits Roshan and final clearing may retain a dispersing bunny silhouette. Approved opening must contain required Roshan; endpoint has zero pinning bunnies. Wing row illustrations are not measured wingbeat phases. Keep original-book Eagle proportions, not generic fluffy bird.

Small friend scale still varies in final close compositions. Fix its world size relative to Roshan and rug through airborne/contact frames. No lingering giant body or ears; all four helpers remain in ensemble. Tools require exact source/role review.

Cloud friend is still a stylized concept and hand tools vary. Bind exact rainbow/brush identities through the approved complete opening; one Eagle plus one rainbow friend, never two bunnies. Wide endpoint must preserve four small left arches and single royal right arch.

Use exact single candle design and verified unlit-then-lit state; six tiers/five strawberries and earned object inventory need exact review. Party hats/costumes persist; no extra prop or flame inferred from board.

Claw actor is corrected, but candle shape and cake decorations remain illustrative. Prince must be present from start of exit shot and both royals must actually clear frame at endpoint; final sketch shows an intermediate departure, not its required end state.
